title: A single-direction many-to-many cardinality relationship does not filter back
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Target[Category] = "Accessories" ) )

source.quote: for many-to-many relationships, cross filter direction can be from either one of the tables, or from both tables
source.supports: the direction of a many-to-many relationship can be from one table only

derivation: The relationship filters from Product to Target only. A filter on Target[Category] does not reach Product: 3 rows.
